_readme: Debug-build notes for this repository's release family. Not shared: a debug build's number belongs to one
family, so these stay out of the global changelog.json. Shown only by debug builds, newest first, for builds
newer than the last one the device saw. Add a line before publishing a debug build.

notes.text: Download diagnostics and offline playback groundwork.
Automatic / Assisted / Manual download flows and the new Downloads screen. Logs file sizes for calibration.
Setup asks about downloads; Settings → Downloads rebuilt; this screen now comes from the changelog.
Downloads no longer hang on a dead connection or throw away a partial file; season progress counts the whole season.
Seasons in Assisted find their sources in the background and tell you when to choose a quality; a long pause keeps the partial file when its link expires.
Assisted seasons can be given a quality with Choose now while sources are still being found, from clearly labelled size estimates.
Downloads is back in the sidebar as its own page, laid out in two panes on wide windows; after Choose now the season stays visible while its sources are checked.
Download sizes are recalibrated from real files: Small, Standard (recommended), Large, Huge and Any, each showing its GB per hour at 1080p and 4K.

The setup wizard is simpler to read: sizes are a list with GB per hour at 1080p and 4K (Standard recommended), playback quality limits have names, Assisted is the recommended Download Mode, and the Sources step says what is already set up. A title's Download button is back on wide windows. "Choose now" now says it uses size estimates.

Downloads has a new library: titles on this device are backdrop cards with their logo, what's next and a play button. A show's page has the title's details, Resume, seasons as tabs and compact episode rows with stills, descriptions and watched marks; a season's watched episodes can be deleted in one go. Title details are saved for offline use.

A downloaded show's page now says it is the copy on this device, with a Downloaded badge and an On this device summary. Desktop: with nothing downloading, Downloads shows your library as a grid; while downloads run, the library sits beside them as banners. Desktop downloads no longer stop and retry every 60 seconds on debrid sources.

Finished downloads are sorted into Title / Season folders, and existing ones move there on first launch; the Downloaded chip on a show's page is gone. Fixes from the final review: downloads no longer wait forever on a connection Windows marks as metered; a profile switch during a background season no longer touches another profile's downloads or loses an early Choose now; offline autoplay stops at the end of what is downloaded; a file that vanished just before playing no longer falls back to online sources.

First debug build on the upstream sync (vanilla 0.1.26-alpha plus the UX convergence): upstream's top bar, now with Downloads and Social (the sidebar is still selectable; narrow windows use the top bar), upstream's dialogs, sheets and menus, skip movie credits, your subtitle choice carried to the next episode, a smoother Home banner, custom posters kept when you return to a title, shimmering source-list labels, TMDB details on by default, and Nuvio Z keeping its own sign-in. Plus the setup + settings pass: Advanced Setup (Settings → Setup & about, the Done page, the What's New card), a reorganised Settings with Navigation and About pages, Welcome back when a profile arrives from a phone, and sync and sign-out fixes.

Advanced Setup polish from the device pass: the Player, Home, Detail page, Enhanced metadata and Source list previews now show the app's real screens; the Navigation preview uses the real sidebar and top bar, and hover previews can be tried on the sample cards; Set up in Settings opens the page over Advanced Setup and Back returns to where you were; Social switches respond at once; a clearer Take the full tour; the tour no longer slides the whole screen. The top bar no longer shortens Downloads to Downl.... Welcome back on desktop now also sets up the sidebar or top bar.

TMDB details work again: builds now carry Nuvio's built-in TMDB key, so cast, artwork, episode details and More like this come from TMDB with no key of your own (75 shipped without one). On Windows, Advanced Setup's Hover panel no longer offers trailer switches, because trailers cannot play on hover there yet; the preview card itself still works. Player previews show a real episode frame.

Playback: removes an incorrect 'No safe automatic source' toast after a chosen source has been handed to the player. The source-selection watchdog now respects manual startup and player ownership; genuine automatic-selection failures still return to the source list.

Watch Together: Away and buffering holds now retain independent ownership, and a skipped Away pause is retried. Returning guests must report fresh playback readiness before the normal short recovery settle. Includes durable Away support and logs for the Home/lock acceptance retest.

Sign-in, sign-out and account switching reworked so an old or failed attempt can't override a newer one; profile selection after sign-in fixed. Watch Together Away and return-readiness fixes from 80 remain.

What's New is now one changelog across Desktop, Android and iPhone. This build previews the next release's notes: they open once after this update, and stay in Settings → What's New, which shows a New badge while something is unseen. Entries for phones sit at the end of each update. Everything in 81 is here too.

Social V2 on top of 0.1.26-alpha-z2: Watching Now as backdrop cards with a join sheet, Recently watched as a per-friend timeline of stacked stills, Friends / Inbox / profile sheet, and an unread dot on Social (sent requests and per-friend switches appear once the Social server update is live). No Reaction Mode in this build.

Tray and pop-ups: the first time you close Nuvio it asks whether to keep it in the tray (next to the clock) so friends' pop-ups can still reach you; it then uses little memory until you open it again from the tray icon. Pop-ups show friend requests, party invites and requests to join you - click one to open Nuvio right there. Social settings now live behind a gear in the Social tab (privacy, pop-ups, closing the window, Show friends on Home), and Inbox opens as a side panel. Settings -> Downloads now looks and works like the other Settings pages and keeps the sidebar.

Opening Nuvio from the Start menu or a shortcut while it is already running (minimised, or in the tray) now brings that window back instead of starting a second copy; links that open Nuvio go to the running copy too. Friends' "started watching" pop-ups now work: turn on Notify on a friend's profile to get them. On the Home friends shelf, the "3h ago" label sits on a small dark chip so it reads on bright pictures. Everything in 98 is here too.

Party invites now say Sent, with an x to take one back; an invite that is ignored just stays Sent, and one that is declined says Declined (you can invite that friend again after 5 minutes). If someone turns down your request to join, you are told, even while you are watching something. Recently watched shows the show's name and picture instead of an episode's, and reads "Latest S5 E7 · 38 watched". Everything in 99 is here too.
Check for updates finds the newest debug build again; it was picking whichever one GitHub listed first.
Social pop-ups show while you're watching: they appear at the top-right over the player, and clicking one there just closes it.
Social pop-ups always appear in their own corner of the screen, like Steam, whether Nuvio is in front, behind something or playing a video.
